channel.title: Surya Kant Sahu
channel.description: Notes on machine learning: transformers, learning theory, audio, and running models in places they were not built for.

item.title: Attention, from the softmax up
item.description: Scaled dot-product attention one piece at a time, with a temperature dial you can turn to watch a query make up its mind.

item.title: A language model in this tab
item.description: A small instruction-tuned model running on your GPU through WebGPU, inside the page, with nothing sent to a server.

item.title: Low-rank updates, plotted
item.description: What LoRA's rank actually buys you, as pixels and as curves. A sketch of a sweep, with charts you can hover, filter and smooth.

item.title: Watching an optimiser move
item.description: Gradient descent with momentum on a surface you can click, and a short film of a diffusion model turning noise into a spiral.
